summary: 周日。nero_eth 和 Barnabé 都在算 Glamsterdam 的容量账：gas 上限从 60M 提到 200M，约 3.3 倍，下一步 300M 也现实；blob 空间也会增加。EIP-8151（账户代码受限的 ecRecover）对齐 EIP-8038 的访问 gas。Starknet 的非约束投票中 99.95% 票权支持探索转为独立的后量子 L1。

summary_en: A Sunday. nero_eth and Barnabé both ran the numbers on Glamsterdam's capacity: the gas limit goes from 60M to 200M, about 3.3x, and 300M looks realistic as a next step, with more blob space too. EIP-8151 (account-code-restricted ecRecover) aligned with EIP-8038 access gas. In Starknet's non-binding vote, 99.95% of the voting power supports exploring a move to an independent post-quantum L1.
